```artifact
Feature: Alarms - U04

  Scenario: Compute HIGH VTE alarm when VTE exceeds threshold [RW-SW-15]
    Given the current breath VTE is 150 mL
    When the breath is processed
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is "medium" [RW-SW-17]

  Scenario Outline: Compute HIGH VTE alarm with varying VTE values [RW-SW-15]
    Given the current breath VTE is <vte_value> mL
    When the breath is processed
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm is <alarm_active>
    Examples:
      | vte_value | alarm_active |
      | 140       | false        |
      | 150       | true         |
      | 200       | true         |
      | 149       | false        |

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath [RW-SW-18]
    Given a breath is initiated
    When the breath is processed
    Then the VTE for the current breath is computed

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm priority is medium [RW-SW-16]
    Given a "LOW VTE" alarm is active
    Then the alarm priority is "medium"

  Scenario Outline: Pressure High Alarm Cancellation - Retrigger Delay [RW-SW-19]
    Given a "pressure high" alarm is triggered
    When the alarm is cancelled
    Then the alarm does not re-trigger for 2 minutes
    Examples:
      | delay_seconds |
      | 60            |
      | 120           |
      | 180           |
      | 240           |

  Scenario: High Priority Alarm - O2 Disconnection [RW-SW-20]
    Given the O2 input line is disconnected
    When the system checks for O2 input
    Then a high-priority alarm is triggered

  Scenario Outline: Display Multiple Active Alarms [RW-SW-22]
    Given the following alarms are active:
      | Alarm Name |
      | HIGH VTE   |
      | LOW VTE    |
      | Pressure High |
    When the GUI displays active alarms
    Then all active alarms are displayed

  Scenario Outline: Event Log - Confirmed Alarm Settings [RW-SW-26]
    Given an alarm "<alarm_name>" is triggered
    When the alarm is confirmed
    Then the event log includes the confirmed alarm setting "<alarm_name>"
    Examples:
      | alarm_name |
      | HIGH VTE   |
      | LOW VTE    |
      | Pressure High |
```
